title: Newmark Arranges Sale of Prominent Lincoln Road Retail Asset in Miami Beach
summary: Newmark announces the Company has arranged the sale of 318-334 Lincoln Road, a 24,339-square-foot retail property located along Miami Beach's iconic Lincoln Road shopping corridor.
